title: Genomic DNA Isolation from Tissue Samples and Library Prep for Tuba-Seq Barcode Analysis
protocol: Make Lysis Buffer by mixing the specified components.
Place tissue in a 50 mL conical tube with 10 mL of Lysis Buffer and 100 μl proteinase K (1:100 dilution).
Add "benchmark" controls to the tube.
Homogenize the solution using the TissueMeister for 15-45 seconds.
Sterilize the TissueMeister in water, followed by bleach, then 70% EtOH, and finally PBS between samples. Change water after every sample; other wash liquids can be used up to three or four times.
Repeat the homogenization process for remaining samples.
Incubate tubes at 55°C overnight in a water bath or incubator.
Take 500 μl of the cell lysate from the digestion step and mix well.
Add 300 μl saturated NaCl to the lysate.
Shake 200 times, then centrifuge at 14K rpm for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Transfer 500 μl of supernatant to a new tube.
Add 500 μl phenol/chloroform/IAA (use another bottle if it is red) to the transferred solution.
Shake 200 times, then centrifuge for 5 minutes at 13000 rpm.
Withdraw approximately 400 μl of the top layer carefully.
Add an equal volume of chloroform to the withdrawn top layer.
Shake 200 times and centrifuge for 5 minutes at maximum speed.
Transfer the aqueous top layer (do not be greedy) to a tube containing 2.5 volumes of 100% ethanol and 1/30th volume of 3M Sodium Acetate pH5.2.
Shake to precipitate the DNA.
Spin for 2 minutes at 13000rpm, then decant and wash with 70% ethanol.
Spin for 30 seconds at 13000rpm, then decant and withdraw all liquid without air drying too much.
Add 200ul TE to the sample and incubate overnight at 37°C.
Measure DNA concentration using a Nanodrop and record 260/280 and 260/230 ratios.
Prepare Master Mix: Combine 32 ug gDNA, 32 ul Primer Mix (10uM), and 400 ul OneTaq (NEB).
Split the Master Mix into 8 individual wells of an 8-strip PCR tube, then spin down.
Run PCR Program starting with a denaturation step at 94°C for 10 minutes.
Cycle through 32 cycles: Denature at 94°C for 30 seconds, anneal at 55°C for 30 seconds, extend at 68°C for 30 seconds.
Final extension at 68°C for 7 minutes followed by holding at 4°C.
Pool PCR reactions back to a volume of 800ul.
Run out 100 ul of the PCR product on a 5% agarose gel.
Extract the PCR product from the gel using the Qiagen MinElute Gel Purification Kit and elute in 25 ul H2O.
Send samples for BioAnalyzer QC DNA 1000 assay to obtain molar concentration and confirm product size.
